text:
Ava Martinez: Support reported a migration surprise  embeds changed dims after alias swap.
Diego Rivera: Do we have a repro?
Ava Martinez: Yes. Quickstart used `client.embed({ input })` and alias resolved to a smaller model. Index mismatched.
Hannah Kim: Immediate actions: 1) Update quickstart to pin embed model id. 2) Add a migration caveat about alias fallthrough. 3) Add a tiny docs smoke check for embed length.
Diego Rivera: I'll update JS + Py snippets to `model: 'h2o-embed-1536'`.
Hannah Kim: I'll draft the migration paragraph and a banner. Copy: "Verify embedding model and vector dimensionality after migration; pin model IDs in production."
Ava Martinez: Can we add a non-blocking CI check that warns if embed dim changes?
Diego Rivera: Yes  will add a smoke test that only fails on a docs-owner label.
docs-bot: Issue created: "docs: embed alias dim caveat" (#5012)
Hannah Kim: Draft pushed to branch `docs/embed-alias-caveat`. Requesting review.
Ava Martinez: Thanks. Once merged we'll add changelog blurb and notify support templates.
docs-bot: Smoke job queued for docs-embed-dim-check.
